newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Pakistan president puts economic growth at 5.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan president puts economic growth at 5.5 pct.

text.p: Pakistani President Farooq Leghari said on Monday his country's economy was currently growing at a rate of 5.5 percent, the official WAM news agency reported.

Speaking at a news conference after meeting with United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, he said Pakistan hoped to raise its growth rate to between seven and eight percent. WAM did not give a time frame for the increase.
Leghari did not specify whether the current growth rate was real or nominal.
In 1995/6 Pakistan's economy grew by a real 6.1 percent from 4.4 percent in 1994/5.
